meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 它会先把请求分成提交、改写分支历史、查询历史、查看状态四类再动手:只在你明确要求时才执行提交、rebase 或删除,单纯排查的请求只报告结论;动手前先读仓库当前状态。
howto.when: 当任务需要产生一次提交或调查 git 历史时接管,普通代码编辑不触发;它会先读仓库状态再判定请求属于哪一类。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看完整 diff,按行为分组后逐个提交

say.text: 查一下这几行最后是谁改的
say.note: 用 blame 给出提交哈希和作者

say.text: 把这个 fixup 自动 squash 进之前那个提交
say.note: 走 autosquash rebase 改写历史

howto.what_en: It classifies a Git request into commit, history-rewrite, history-query, or status-check, then acts: it writes history only when you explicitly ask, and only reports findings for investigative asks. It reads repo state first.
howto.when_en: Use it when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; ordinary code edits are skipped. It reads repository state before classifying the request.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: Reads the full diff, groups by behavior, commits each
blame returns the commit hash and author

say_en.text: Autosquash this fixup into the earlier commit
say_en.note: Runs an autosquash rebase to rewrite history
